decisionRule: An alternate displaces bge-small only if it beats it on recorded-slice hit@5 by ≥ 3.0 absolute points AND its recorded-slice hit@1 is not lower; the report must note dim/cost consequences (gte 768-d = 2× vector storage, ~4.4× model bytes) — ties go to bge-small.
The floor is "acceptable beyond emergency mode" only if its recorded-slice hit@5 is within 10.0 absolute points of the winner's.

τ_dense per profile (locked default AND floor) = the 5th percentile of gold-pair cosine similarities on the recorded slice, rounded DOWN to 2 decimals — a permissive admission floor; the gold and random-pair distributions are recorded so the number is auditable.

verdict.rationale: No native alternate cleared both displacement margins; the default remains bge-small, including on ties.
verdict.costConsequences: gte-modernbert-base uses 768 dimensions: 2× bge-small vector storage and approximately 4.4× model bytes.

languageMix: English-only validated; multilingual unbenched; granite-multilingual-r2 is the documented escape hatch, benched when a real non-English app arrives.
